By way of ther writ petition, the petitioner has prayed for following reliefs:
"10.1.That, this Hon'ble Court kindly be pleased to direct the respondents for complying the para no. 1, 4, 6, 7 and 10 of memo dated 03.02.2016 issued by Commissioner Bilaspur Division Bilaspur.
10.2 That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct the respondents for providing benefit of Schedule I, II and III of Act, 2013.
10.3 That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct the respondents for compliance of Memo dated 04.08.2017 issued by Ministry of Coal.
10.4 Any other relief, which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper, may also be passed in favour of the petitioner."

3. At the very outset, learned counsel for petitioners submits that the petitioners confine their claim in the present Writ Petition for an appropriate direction to respondents No.3 to 5 to consider the claim of the petitioners for appropriate relief which the petitioners would be entitled for under the Second Schedule of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

6. Accordingly, the petition stands disposed of with aforesaid observations and directions.
